name: SCOS Memory Fabric
description: Additive SCOS memory corpus/prompt supplement plus governed read and (opt-in) write tools, called directly against mcp-gateway.

gatewayUrl.description: SCOS mcp-gateway MCP endpoint. Falls back to SCOS_GATEWAY_URL.

bearerToken.description: SCOS bearer token. Falls back to SCOS_BEARER_TOKEN in ~/.hermes/scos.env.

tenantId.description: SCOS tenant id. Falls back to SCOS_TENANT_ID.

principalId.description: SCOS principal id. Falls back to SCOS_PRINCIPAL_ID.

recallTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for recall/supplement calls in ms.

maxRetries.description: Bounded retries for transient gateway failures.

enableCorpusSupplement.description: Include SCOS in memory_search corpus results (additive; does not own the memory slot).

enablePromptSupplement.description: Add a short SCOS guidance line to the memory prompt section.

promptSummary.description: Inject a bounded cached SCOS fact summary pre-turn. Adds one cached gateway call.

promptSummaryTtlMs.description: TTL for the cached pre-turn SCOS summary.

allowWrites.description: Expose scos_correct/scos_forget. Off by default; these mutate stored memory.
